title: MIC-50-90: A Python package for bounding MIC distributions from incomplete susceptibility reports
description:
MIC-50-90 2.0.0 is a Python package for bounding MIC distributions from incomplete susceptibility reports. Published antimicrobial susceptibility results often give only MIC50, MIC90, a range and a few percentages. From these, and from exact or rounded counts, MIC-50-90 computes the smallest and largest count the report allows in every MIC category and range, names the count that would narrow an open question most, selects counts a laboratory can publish so that readers can check its conclusions, and gives optional population bounds under stated sampling assumptions. The command line, the Python interface and the Galaxy tools produce graphical HTML reports, CSV/JSON results and reusable settings.

Users can distinguish missing counts from measurement censoring, update the same collection with additional counts, select concentration groups at a requested precision, and prepare a sufficient laboratory report for independent checking. Sample identification, population confidence under independent observations from the same distribution, and calibration for exchangeable study units have separate assumptions.

This release contains software, tests, formal algebra, example inputs, user documentation, build instructions and checksums. It excludes the manuscript, supplementary appendices and editorial figures. MIT applies to the software; example data and bundled fonts retain their own attributed terms.
